conditions: Another GPU workload (krea2) remained active. Alternating arms on one shared generated corpus, changing queries, three warmups. Benchmarks ran sequentially, separately from our GPU correctness tests. Clocks and competing workload were not controlled. No outliers were removed.
interpretation: Compare each run's arms, not absolute latency across runs. Ordinary completed search times exclude setup, compilation, profiling and three warmups. The first warmup records the candidate graph where applicable.

Selection comparisons queue both arms immediately; replay comparisons use identical kernels and change only ordinary submission; combined comparisons compare the previous selector/immediate submission against the new selector/cached graph. k>32 uses the existing sorted selector, so only graph reuse applies.

Profile replays are separately recorded instrumented graphs in both arms, collected after ordinary timings. They identify kernel changes; they do not directly measure immediate-versus-cached host submission savings. Never subtract profile intervals from ordinary host samples.

All returned IDs/score bits and final-tile score bytes matched. Standalone selector tests also compare raw outputs with the predecessor and CPU tie-order oracles for NaNs, infinities, signed zeros, subnormals, tails, multiple merge levels, and nonzero global ID offsets.

The detailed compiler reports below are complete for both first/merge selectors. ISA counts are static instructions, not dynamic counters. Occupancy is modeled and unknown bank-service fields remain null.

All ordinary samples and per-stage profile samples are retained. Full raw command/timestamp samples are included for the representative 1M top-32 comparison; the harness regenerates them for all other shapes.

Exploration wave-pairs combines all eight winners in vector registers; wave-pairs-double alternates shared-memory slots to remove a barrier. The chosen clustered version also distributes the final reduction over eight-lane clusters. The rejected sources are retained below for reproduction with CANDIDATE_SOURCE.
Initial clustered-source runs differ from production only in comments. Their source digests are retained; the representative executables have identical bytes.

exploration_sources.wave-pairs:
// Each group owns 1024 candidates. Repeated max-score/min-ID reductions give
// exact, deterministic top-k. Both score and ID are invalidated together.
amdgpu.target<gfx1151> @target {subgroup_size = 32}
config.decl @db.select.limit : %value: index where [range(%value, 1, 1073741824)]
config.decl @db.batch : %value: index where [range(%value, 1, 64)]
config.decl @db.select.first : %value: index where [range(%value, 0, 1)]
template.decl @db.candidate_id(%first: index, %ids: buffer, %count: index, %at: index, %input_offset: offset, %row_base: index) -> (i32)
template.def<@db.candidate_id> @db.row_id(%first: index, %ids: buffer, %count: index, %at: index, %input_offset: offset, %row_base: index) -> (i32) where [eq(%first, 1)] {
  %global = index.add %at, %row_base : index
  %id = index.cast %global : index to i32
  template.return %id : i32
}
template.def<@db.candidate_id> @db.merge_id(%first: index, %ids: buffer, %count: index, %at: index, %input_offset: offset, %row_base: index) -> (i32) where [eq(%first, 0)] {
  %zero = index.constant 0 : offset
  %iv = buffer.view %ids[%input_offset] : buffer -> view<[%count]xi32>
  %id = view.load %iv[%at] : view<[%count]xi32> -> i32
  template.return %id : i32
}
kernel.def target(@target) export("select") @select(%count_arg: i32) {
  %one = index.constant 1 : index
  %batch = config.get @db.batch : index
  %threads = index.constant 256 : index
  %count_raw = index.cast %count_arg : i32 to index
  %count = index.assume %count_raw [range(%count_raw, 1, 1073741824)] : index
  %c1023 = index.constant 1023 : index
  %c1024 = index.constant 1024 : index
  %rounded = index.add %count, %c1023 : index
  %groups = index.div %rounded, %c1024 : index
  kernel.launch.config workgroups(%groups, %batch, %one) workgroup_size(%threads, %one, %one) : index
} launch(%count_arg: i32, %k_arg: i32, %row_base_arg: i32, %scores: buffer, %ids: buffer, %out_scores: buffer, %out_ids: buffer) {
  %first = config.get @db.select.first : index
  %zero = index.constant 0 : offset
  %i0 = index.constant 0 : index
  %i1 = index.constant 1 : index
  %i4 = index.constant 4 : index
  %c256 = index.constant 256 : index
  %c1023 = index.constant 1023 : index
  %c1024 = index.constant 1024 : index
  %tid0 = kernel.workitem.id<x> : index
  %tid = index.assume %tid0 [range(%tid0, 0, 255)] : index
  %group0 = kernel.workgroup.id<x> : index
  %group = index.assume %group0 [range(%group0, 0, 1048575)] : index
  %count0 = index.cast %count_arg : i32 to index
  %count = index.assume %count0 [range(%count0, 1, 1073741824)] : index
  %k0 = index.cast %k_arg : i32 to index
  %k = index.assume %k0 [range(%k0, 1, 32)] : index
  %base = index.mul %group, %c1024 : index
  %start = index.add %base, %tid : index
  %outbase = index.mul %group, %k : index
  %rounded = index.add %count, %c1023 : index
  %groups = index.div %rounded, %c1024 : index
  %out_count = index.mul %groups, %k : index
  %query0 = kernel.workgroup.id<y> : index
  %batch_count = config.get @db.batch : index
  %query = index.assume %query0 [range(%query0, 0, 63), lt(%query0, %batch_count)] : index
  %limit = config.get @db.select.limit : index
  %input_span = index.assume %count [range(%count, 1, 1073741824), le(%count, %limit)] : index
  %output_span = index.assume %out_count [range(%out_count, 1, 1073741824), le(%out_count, %limit)] : index
  %c4offset = index.constant 4 : offset
  %input_bytes = index.scale %input_span, %c4offset : index, offset -> offset
  %input_offset = index.scale %query, %input_bytes : index, offset -> offset
  %output_bytes = index.scale %output_span, %c4offset : index, offset -> offset
  %output_offset = index.scale %query, %output_bytes : index, offset -> offset
  %row_base_raw = index.cast %row_base_arg : i32 to index
  %row_base = index.assume %row_base_raw [range(%row_base_raw, 0, 1073741823)] : index
  %sv = buffer.view %scores[%input_offset] : buffer -> view<[%count]xf32>
  %os = buffer.view %out_scores[%output_offset] : buffer -> view<[%out_count]xf32>
  %oi = buffer.view %out_ids[%output_offset] : buffer -> view<[%out_count]xi32>
  %badbits = scalar.constant -8388608 : i32
  %neg = scalar.bitcast %badbits : i32 to f32
  %sentinel = scalar.constant 2147483647 : i32
  %negs = vector.splat %neg : vector<4xf32>
  %sentinels = vector.splat %sentinel : vector<4xi32>
  %leader = index.cmp eq, %tid, %i0 : index
  %initial_scores, %initial_ids = scf.for %j = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1](%ss = %negs : vector<4xf32>, %ii = %sentinels : vector<4xi32>) -> (vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>) unroll {
    %off = index.mul %j, %c256 : index
    %ix = index.add %start, %off : index
    %valid = index.cmp ult, %ix, %count : index
    %safe = scf.select %valid, %ix, %i0 : index
    %at = index.assume %safe [range(%safe, 0, 1073741823), lt(%safe, %count)] : index
    %value = view.load %sv[%at] : view<[%count]xf32> -> f32
    %ident = template.apply<@db.candidate_id>(%first, %ids, %count, %at, %input_offset, %row_base) : (index, buffer, index, index, offset, index) -> (i32)
    %ordered = scalar.cmpf ord, %value, %value : f32
    %live = scalar.andi %valid, %ordered : i1
    %score = scf.select %live, %value, %neg : f32
    %id = scf.select %valid, %ident, %sentinel : i32
    %next_s = vector.insert %score into %ss[%j] : f32, vector<4xf32>
    %next_i = vector.insert %id into %ii[%j] : i32, vector<4xi32>
    scf.yield %next_s, %next_i : vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>
  }
  %lane0 = kernel.subgroup.lane.id : index
  %lane = index.assume %lane0 [range(%lane0, 0, 31)] : index
  %wave0 = kernel.subgroup.id : index
  %wave = index.assume %wave0 [range(%wave0, 0, 7)] : index
  %wave_leader = index.cmp eq, %lane, %i0 : index
  %scratch_bytes = index.constant 32 : offset
  %score_scratch = buffer.alloca<workgroup> align(16) %scratch_bytes : buffer
  %id_scratch = buffer.alloca<workgroup> align(16) %scratch_bytes : buffer
  %ws = buffer.view %score_scratch[%zero] : buffer -> view<8xf32>
  %wi = buffer.view %id_scratch[%zero] : buffer -> view<8xi32>
  %end_scores, %end_ids = scf.for %rank = [%i0 to %k step %i1](%ss = %initial_scores : vector<4xf32>, %ii = %initial_ids : vector<4xi32>) -> (vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>) {
    %local = vector.reduce<maxnumf> %ss, %neg : vector<4xf32>, f32
    %wave_score = kernel.subgroup.reduce<maxnumf> %local : f32
    %wave_scores = vector.splat %wave_score : vector<4xf32>
    %equal = vector.cmpf oeq, %ss, %wave_scores : vector<4xf32> -> vector<4xi1>
    %candidates = vector.select %equal, %ii, %sentinels : vector<4xi32>
    %local_id = vector.reduce<minui> %candidates, %sentinel : vector<4xi32>, i32
    %wave_id = kernel.subgroup.reduce<minui> %local_id : i32
    scf.if %wave_leader {
      view.store %wave_score, %ws[%wave] : f32, view<8xf32>
      view.store %wave_id, %wi[%wave] : i32, view<8xi32>
    }
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    %all_scores = vector.load %ws[%i0] : view<8xf32> -> vector<8xf32>
    %all_ids = vector.load %wi[%i0] : view<8xi32> -> vector<8xi32>
    %best = vector.reduce<maxnumf> %all_scores, %neg : vector<8xf32>, f32
    %bests = vector.splat %best : vector<8xf32>
    %tied = vector.cmpf oeq, %all_scores, %bests : vector<8xf32> -> vector<8xi1>
    %invalids = vector.splat %sentinel : vector<8xi32>
    %tied_ids = vector.select %tied, %all_ids, %invalids : vector<8xi32>
    %best_id = vector.reduce<minui> %tied_ids, %sentinel : vector<8xi32>, i32
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    scf.if %leader {
      %out0 = index.add %outbase, %rank : index
      %out = index.assume %out0 [range(%out0, 0, 33554431), lt(%out0, %out_count)] : index
      view.store %best, %os[%out] : f32, view<[%out_count]xf32>
      view.store %best_id, %oi[%out] : i32, view<[%out_count]xi32>
    }
    %best_ids = vector.splat %best_id : vector<4xi32>
    %chosen = vector.cmpi eq, %ii, %best_ids : vector<4xi32> -> vector<4xi1>
    %next_s = vector.select %chosen, %negs, %ss : vector<4xf32>
    %next_i = vector.select %chosen, %sentinels, %ii : vector<4xi32>
    scf.yield %next_s, %next_i : vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>
  }
  kernel.return
}

    %equal = vector.cmpf oeq, %ss, %wave_scores : vector<4xf32> -> vector<4xi1>
    %candidates = vector.select %equal, %ii, %sentinels : vector<4xi32>
    %local_id = vector.reduce<minui> %candidates, %sentinel : vector<4xi32>, i32
    %wave_id = kernel.subgroup.reduce<minui> %local_id : i32
    %i2 = index.constant 2 : index
    %i8 = index.constant 8 : index
    %parity = index.rem %rank, %i2 : index
    %scratch_base = index.mul %parity, %i8 : index
    %scratch_at = index.add %scratch_base, %wave : index
    scf.if %wave_leader {
      view.store %wave_score, %ws[%scratch_at] : f32, view<16xf32>
      view.store %wave_id, %wi[%scratch_at] : i32, view<16xi32>
    }
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    %all_scores = vector.load %ws[%scratch_base] : view<16xf32> -> vector<8xf32>
    %all_ids = vector.load %wi[%scratch_base] : view<16xi32> -> vector<8xi32>
    %best = vector.reduce<maxnumf> %all_scores, %neg : vector<8xf32>, f32
    %bests = vector.splat %best : vector<8xf32>
    %tied = vector.cmpf oeq, %all_scores, %bests : vector<8xf32> -> vector<8xi1>
    %invalids = vector.splat %sentinel : vector<8xi32>
    %tied_ids = vector.select %tied, %all_ids, %invalids : vector<8xi32>
    %best_id = vector.reduce<minui> %tied_ids, %sentinel : vector<8xi32>, i32
    scf.if %leader {
      %out0 = index.add %outbase, %rank : index
      %out = index.assume %out0 [range(%out0, 0, 33554431), lt(%out0, %out_count)] : index
      view.store %best, %os[%out] : f32, view<[%out_count]xf32>
      view.store %best_id, %oi[%out] : i32, view<[%out_count]xi32>
    }
    %best_ids = vector.splat %best_id : vector<4xi32>
    %chosen = vector.cmpi eq, %ii, %best_ids : vector<4xi32> -> vector<4xi1>
    %next_s = vector.select %chosen, %negs, %ss : vector<4xf32>
    %next_i = vector.select %chosen, %sentinels, %ii : vector<4xi32>
    scf.yield %next_s, %next_i : vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>
  }
  kernel.return
}

// Each group owns 1024 candidates. Repeated max-score/min-ID reductions give
// exact, deterministic top-k. Both score and ID are invalidated together.
amdgpu.target<gfx1151> @target {subgroup_size = 32}
config.decl @db.select.limit : %value: index where [range(%value, 1, 1073741824)]
config.decl @db.batch : %value: index where [range(%value, 1, 64)]
config.decl @db.select.first : %value: index where [range(%value, 0, 1)]
template.decl @db.candidate_id(%first: index, %ids: buffer, %count: index, %at: index, %input_offset: offset, %row_base: index) -> (i32)
template.def<@db.candidate_id> @db.row_id(%first: index, %ids: buffer, %count: index, %at: index, %input_offset: offset, %row_base: index) -> (i32) where [eq(%first, 1)] {
  %global = index.add %at, %row_base : index
  %id = index.cast %global : index to i32
  template.return %id : i32
}
template.def<@db.candidate_id> @db.merge_id(%first: index, %ids: buffer, %count: index, %at: index, %input_offset: offset, %row_base: index) -> (i32) where [eq(%first, 0)] {
  %zero = index.constant 0 : offset
  %iv = buffer.view %ids[%input_offset] : buffer -> view<[%count]xi32>
  %id = view.load %iv[%at] : view<[%count]xi32> -> i32
  template.return %id : i32
}
kernel.def target(@target) export("select") @select(%count_arg: i32) {
  %one = index.constant 1 : index
  %batch = config.get @db.batch : index
  %threads = index.constant 256 : index
  %count_raw = index.cast %count_arg : i32 to index
  %count = index.assume %count_raw [range(%count_raw, 1, 1073741824)] : index
  %c1023 = index.constant 1023 : index
  %c1024 = index.constant 1024 : index
  %rounded = index.add %count, %c1023 : index
  %groups = index.div %rounded, %c1024 : index
  kernel.launch.config workgroups(%groups, %batch, %one) workgroup_size(%threads, %one, %one) : index
} launch(%count_arg: i32, %k_arg: i32, %row_base_arg: i32, %scores: buffer, %ids: buffer, %out_scores: buffer, %out_ids: buffer) {
  %first = config.get @db.select.first : index
  %zero = index.constant 0 : offset
  %i0 = index.constant 0 : index
  %i1 = index.constant 1 : index
  %i4 = index.constant 4 : index
  %c256 = index.constant 256 : index
  %c1023 = index.constant 1023 : index
  %c1024 = index.constant 1024 : index
  %tid0 = kernel.workitem.id<x> : index
  %tid = index.assume %tid0 [range(%tid0, 0, 255)] : index
  %group0 = kernel.workgroup.id<x> : index
  %group = index.assume %group0 [range(%group0, 0, 1048575)] : index
  %count0 = index.cast %count_arg : i32 to index
  %count = index.assume %count0 [range(%count0, 1, 1073741824)] : index
  %k0 = index.cast %k_arg : i32 to index
  %k = index.assume %k0 [range(%k0, 1, 32)] : index
  %base = index.mul %group, %c1024 : index
  %start = index.add %base, %tid : index
  %outbase = index.mul %group, %k : index
  %rounded = index.add %count, %c1023 : index
  %groups = index.div %rounded, %c1024 : index
  %out_count = index.mul %groups, %k : index
  %query0 = kernel.workgroup.id<y> : index
  %batch_count = config.get @db.batch : index
  %query = index.assume %query0 [range(%query0, 0, 63), lt(%query0, %batch_count)] : index
  %limit = config.get @db.select.limit : index
  %input_span = index.assume %count [range(%count, 1, 1073741824), le(%count, %limit)] : index
  %output_span = index.assume %out_count [range(%out_count, 1, 1073741824), le(%out_count, %limit)] : index
  %c4offset = index.constant 4 : offset
  %input_bytes = index.scale %input_span, %c4offset : index, offset -> offset
  %input_offset = index.scale %query, %input_bytes : index, offset -> offset
  %output_bytes = index.scale %output_span, %c4offset : index, offset -> offset
  %output_offset = index.scale %query, %output_bytes : index, offset -> offset
  %row_base_raw = index.cast %row_base_arg : i32 to index
  %row_base = index.assume %row_base_raw [range(%row_base_raw, 0, 1073741823)] : index
  %sv = buffer.view %scores[%input_offset] : buffer -> view<[%count]xf32>
  %os = buffer.view %out_scores[%output_offset] : buffer -> view<[%out_count]xf32>
  %oi = buffer.view %out_ids[%output_offset] : buffer -> view<[%out_count]xi32>
  %badbits = scalar.constant -8388608 : i32
  %neg = scalar.bitcast %badbits : i32 to f32
  %sentinel = scalar.constant 2147483647 : i32
  %negs = vector.splat %neg : vector<4xf32>
  %sentinels = vector.splat %sentinel : vector<4xi32>
  %leader = index.cmp eq, %tid, %i0 : index
  %initial_scores, %initial_ids = scf.for %j = [%i0 to %i4 step %i1](%ss = %negs : vector<4xf32>, %ii = %sentinels : vector<4xi32>) -> (vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>) unroll {
    %off = index.mul %j, %c256 : index
    %ix = index.add %start, %off : index
    %valid = index.cmp ult, %ix, %count : index
    %safe = scf.select %valid, %ix, %i0 : index
    %at = index.assume %safe [range(%safe, 0, 1073741823), lt(%safe, %count)] : index
    %value = view.load %sv[%at] : view<[%count]xf32> -> f32
    %ident = template.apply<@db.candidate_id>(%first, %ids, %count, %at, %input_offset, %row_base) : (index, buffer, index, index, offset, index) -> (i32)
    %ordered = scalar.cmpf ord, %value, %value : f32
    %live = scalar.andi %valid, %ordered : i1
    %score = scf.select %live, %value, %neg : f32
    %id = scf.select %valid, %ident, %sentinel : i32
    %next_s = vector.insert %score into %ss[%j] : f32, vector<4xf32>
    %next_i = vector.insert %id into %ii[%j] : i32, vector<4xi32>
    scf.yield %next_s, %next_i : vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>
  }
  %lane0 = kernel.subgroup.lane.id : index
  %lane = index.assume %lane0 [range(%lane0, 0, 31)] : index
  %wave0 = kernel.subgroup.id : index
  %wave = index.assume %wave0 [range(%wave0, 0, 7)] : index
  %wave_leader = index.cmp eq, %lane, %i0 : index
  %scratch_bytes = index.constant 64 : offset
  %score_scratch = buffer.alloca<workgroup> align(16) %scratch_bytes : buffer
  %id_scratch = buffer.alloca<workgroup> align(16) %scratch_bytes : buffer
  %ws = buffer.view %score_scratch[%zero] : buffer -> view<16xf32>
  %wi = buffer.view %id_scratch[%zero] : buffer -> view<16xi32>
  %end_scores, %end_ids = scf.for %rank = [%i0 to %k step %i1](%ss = %initial_scores : vector<4xf32>, %ii = %initial_ids : vector<4xi32>) -> (vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>) {
    %local = vector.reduce<maxnumf> %ss, %neg : vector<4xf32>, f32
    %wave_score = kernel.subgroup.reduce<maxnumf> %local : f32
    %wave_scores = vector.splat %wave_score : vector<4xf32>
    %equal = vector.cmpf oeq, %ss, %wave_scores : vector<4xf32> -> vector<4xi1>
    %candidates = vector.select %equal, %ii, %sentinels : vector<4xi32>
    %local_id = vector.reduce<minui> %candidates, %sentinel : vector<4xi32>, i32
    %wave_id = kernel.subgroup.reduce<minui> %local_id : i32
    %i2 = index.constant 2 : index
    %i8 = index.constant 8 : index
    %parity = index.rem %rank, %i2 : index
    %scratch_base = index.mul %parity, %i8 : index
    %scratch_at = index.add %scratch_base, %wave : index
    scf.if %wave_leader {
      view.store %wave_score, %ws[%scratch_at] : f32, view<16xf32>
      view.store %wave_id, %wi[%scratch_at] : i32, view<16xi32>
    }
    kernel.barrier<workgroup> scope(workgroup) ordering(acq_rel)
    %read_wave = index.rem %lane, %i8 : index
    %read_at = index.add %scratch_base, %read_wave : index
    %peer_score = view.load %ws[%read_at] : view<16xf32> -> f32
    %peer_id = view.load %wi[%read_at] : view<16xi32> -> i32
    %best = kernel.subgroup.reduce<maxnumf> %peer_score {cluster_size = 8} : f32
    %tied = scalar.cmpf oeq, %peer_score, %best : f32
    %tied_id = scf.select %tied, %peer_id, %sentinel : i32
    %best_id = kernel.subgroup.reduce<minui> %tied_id {cluster_size = 8} : i32
    scf.if %leader {
      %out0 = index.add %outbase, %rank : index
      %out = index.assume %out0 [range(%out0, 0, 33554431), lt(%out0, %out_count)] : index
      view.store %best, %os[%out] : f32, view<[%out_count]xf32>
      view.store %best_id, %oi[%out] : i32, view<[%out_count]xi32>
    }
    %best_ids = vector.splat %best_id : vector<4xi32>
    %chosen = vector.cmpi eq, %ii, %best_ids : vector<4xi32> -> vector<4xi1>
    %next_s = vector.select %chosen, %negs, %ss : vector<4xf32>
    %next_i = vector.select %chosen, %sentinels, %ii : vector<4xi32>
    scf.yield %next_s, %next_i : vector<4xf32>, vector<4xi32>
  }
  kernel.return
}
